name: General Public
description: No strong community identity. Moderate opinions. Less reactive. Higher proportion of neutral sentiment.

archetypes.description: casual consumers who buy Nike out of habit
mainstream social media users with passing opinions

profiles.name: JustAGuy_Shopping
profiles.bio: Buy Nike because my kid wants them. Seem fine to me.
profiles.persona_text: Pragmatic consumer. Buys Nike for durability and kid approval. Not engaged in hype. Price-sensitive. Moderate positive sentiment.

profiles.name: MainstreamMom_TX
profiles.bio: Everybody wears Nike. Must be doing something right.
profiles.persona_text: Passive brand loyalty. Buys what's available and well-reviewed. Not aware of drop culture. Positive by default.

profiles.name: RandomReddit_User
profiles.bio: Saw a Nike ad today. Seems overpriced for what it is honestly.
profiles.persona_text: Casual commenter. Forms opinions from news headlines and friend recommendations. Not deeply invested. Slightly skeptical of big brands.

profiles.name: SportsParent_Ohio
profiles.bio: Coach said get Nike cleats. Got Nike cleats. That's it.
profiles.persona_text: Functional buyer. Zero brand enthusiasm. Nike is whatever team sport requires. Neutral-to-positive by default.
